name: Tribes
overview: Scripture reveals the significance of the twelve tribes of Israel as foundational to God's covenant people, each tribe distinct with its own inheritance and identity, as seen in Jacob's blessings and the naming on the high priest's breastplate (Genesis 49:1, 28; Exodus 28:21). The tribes are not only historical divisions but also carry prophetic importance, especially Judah's scepter which points to the coming of Shiloh, the Messiah, to whom the gathering of God's people belongs (Genesis 49:10). God's faithfulness in preserving and regathering Israel, despite their dispersion, underscores His sovereign care as a shepherd over His flock (Jeremiah 31:10), and the tribes maintain their inheritance without transfer, emphasizing God's order and purpose in His people (Numbers 36:9).
